baseline_brep_namespace: Original hierarchy-composed TopLoc_Location, CASCADE Topology V3 Locations 3
host_brep_namespace: Same source definition with gp_Trsf.SetValues from identical full matrix, CASCADE Topology V3 Locations 1
scope: One exact public source occurrence. Both serialized hashes regenerated byte-for-byte from the same native TShape and identical authored occurrence matrix. All native faces, mating plane and four bores measured; serialization identity is not a whole-printer clearance certificate.

inverse_placement_solid_comparison.method: BRepAlgoAPI_Cut/Common, no fuzzy tolerance or geometry repair; inverse each complete native TopLoc_Location to its exact source definition frame
inverse_placement_solid_comparison.boolean_operands: Same parsed native TShape after exact byte identity of both inverse-placement BRep definitions is established; not inferred from bounds or volumes.

coincident_surface_solver_limitation: An independent parse of each byte-identical definition can produce invalid coincident-surface Boolean output (including negative common volume). That calculation is not used as proof. Exact native definition bytes and the original source TShape establish identity before shared-TShape Boolean checks.
